text: Do you ship orders on Saturdays?
reference: Orders are picked and shipped on business days only.
why: Customers ask this every week, and one document answers it.
The same question as the Saturday one. A second copy adds no new test.

text: Who pays the shipping when I send something back?
reference: The customer, unless the item was wrong or defective.
why: A common question with a clear answer in the returns FAQ.

text: Will my order still ship the same day on Christmas Eve?
reference: Warehouses run a reduced shift on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve and close at noon.
why: An edge case of the same-day rule, answered by the holiday schedule.

text: Can enterprise customers get a refund?
reference: The refund policy does NOT apply to enterprise contracts.
why: The assistant once said yes when a chunk cut this sentence in two. Keep it so that can't come back unseen.

text: What is the hotel nightly limit for business travel?
reference: Lodging on work trips is reimbursed up to $210 per night before taxes in most cities and up to $290 per night in high-cost cities listed on the travel desk page.
why: The assistant quoted the 2018 limit. A known failure belongs in the set.
No document mentions it. The right answer is to say so, and the set should check that.

text: Will you match a lower price from another supplier?
why: The documents never answer this. A made-up promise here would cost money.
